result.reason: The added operative language reaches the preferred position: transition assistance is available for up to six months at then-current rates, Sparkling data must be returned in a commonly used machine-readable format within 30 days, and Garman must subsequently delete and certify deletion of that data. The addition leaves the existing termination rights and customer return obligations intact and changes no more than necessary. Drafting is professional, though the 30-day period could be made slightly clearer by stating expressly that it runs from expiry or termination.
